concerns.text: Task **T069** (core stability script) declares a dependency on **T117**, but **T117** is defined later (Phase 11). Consumers must not precede their producers.
Task **T112** (README update) depends on **T031a**, yet **T031a** is defined in Phase 6, after **T112**. This violates producer‑before‑consumer ordering.

All tasks in the US2 block (e.g., T016‑T021, T044‑T059) depend on artifacts produced in the US1 block (e.g., **T015**, **T060**, **T061**). Per the lens, each user‑story group must be independently shippable; cross‑story dependencies break that requirement.

US3 tasks (e.g., T024, T024b, T058, T025, T026, T027) depend on US2 artifacts such as the trained Random Forest model (**T018**) and VIF remediation (**T023b**). This creates a chain of dependencies across user stories, violating the independent‑story criterion.
